items.name: computer-use-fallback-mac
items.summary: Window-scoped macOS Computer Use MCP server providing background window capture and Accessibility control without foreground focus.

items.name: Enterprise Web Workflow Agent
items.summary: Enterprise web workflow agent framework combining browser-use automation, human-in-the-loop safety gates, trace logging, and evaluation.

items.name: desktop-hub
items.summary: Compact 10-tool (~2.3k token) facade MCP server for macOS desktop automation.

items.name: zuhair-01 chrome-agent-bridge
items.summary: Universal Chrome control bridge for OpenCode, Codex, and Claude Code coding agents.

items.name: SnapDOM
items.summary: SnapDOM captures rendered browser elements and exports images or structured page context. Its plugins can provide agents with text, JSON and images paired with element maps.

items.name: SnapEye
items.summary: A SnapDOM-based toolkit that lets coding agents capture, diff and record elements of a running web app through a CLI, an in-page API or URL triggers, with JSON results and exit codes.

items.name: Snapsurf
items.summary: Web navigation and verification layer for AI agents providing compact semantic page digests and typed post-action DOM diffs.

items.name: Domstamp
items.summary: Framework-neutral browser-state snapshotter capturing compact, diffable DOM and accessibility states for AI web agents.

items.name: UI Image to Code Studio
items.summary: Codex skill for converting UI screenshots and live websites into React, Vue, or HTML code with visual browser verification.

items.name: WinAgent-Lite
items.summary: WinAgent-Lite is a local vision-driven Windows GUI agent and MCP server with a reproducible desktop evaluation suite.

items.name: MM-Navigator
items.summary: Example code for the GPT-4V smartphone navigation study: a prompt builder that sends raw and number-tagged screenshots plus action history to GPT-4V for the next Android action, and an action-matching evaluation script.

items.name: WinDeskGround
items.summary: WinDeskGround benchmarks desktop GUI grounding in multi-window Windows environments with controlled occlusion, scaling, and interference levels.

items.summary: Publisher or product brand associated with TinyFish computer-use or browser automation offerings.

items.name: MAI-UI 8B
items.summary: A released MAI-UI checkpoint combining mobile GUI actions, agent-user interaction and tool-use-oriented navigation.

items.name: SE-GUI-7B
items.summary: A 7B GUI grounding model built on Qwen2.5-VL and trained with GRPO, a dense point reward and attention-guided self-evolutionary fine-tuning on 3,018 curated seed samples.

items.name: RICO-WidgetCaptioning
items.summary: A mobile UI dataset pairing RICO screenshots and widget regions with human-written captions. It includes view hierarchies and train, validation, and test splits.

items.name: MyPCBench VM images
items.summary: MyPCBench VM images provides disk images for evaluating computer-use agents on seeded web apps, alongside a task suite with grading rubrics.

items.name: WorkArena-Instances
items.summary: A restricted-access set of ServiceNow instances for running WorkArena benchmark evaluations. The repository provides instance information and states research-use conditions.

items.name: Stagehand
items.summary: An SDK for browser agents that combines Playwright-style page control with natural-language actions, observation, and extraction. It runs beside the browser as an extension.

items.name: AutoGUI-v1-zip
items.summary: A training data repository for AutoGUI containing an annotated GUI set and selected vision datasets, with instructions for merging their JSON files for fine-tuning.

items.name: GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: General OpenAI model whose launch post covers computer use and browsing; OpenAI reports 72.6% on OSWorld 2.0 at about 40 minutes per task, plus ScreenSpot-Pro and Mind2Web results.

items.name: Mind2Web-Live
items.summary: Task files for the WebCanvas live-web benchmark: 438 training and 104 test tasks derived from Mind2Web, each with key-node checks on URLs or page elements that score intermediate progress.

items.name: dassi
items.summary: Side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave whose agent reads pages, takes screenshots, clicks, types, fills forms and manages tabs in the user's signed-in browser, with saved skills, schedules and a choice of model.

items.name: UI-TARS 72B DPO
items.summary: DPO-labelled 72B UI-TARS checkpoint that its card marks as recommended: a native GUI agent model in the Qwen2-VL architecture for screen perception, element grounding and multi-step actions on web, mobile and desktop.

items.name: PC-Agent-E checkpoint
items.summary: Computer-use checkpoint fine-tuned on PC-Agent-E trajectories; the model-card prose identifies Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct as its starting model.

items.name: Hyperbrowser
items.summary: Browser infrastructure and automation services for AI agents.

items.name: ELAM-7B
items.summary: A model fine-tuned on automotive UI screenshots to return tap coordinates for test instructions and judge expected results at relevant interface elements.

items.name: InternVL3_5-4B-HF
items.summary: An HF-format checkpoint in the InternVL3.5 multimodal model family, whose card names GUI interaction among its capabilities. The release includes model weights.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) Qwen3-VL-8B ScienceBoard SFT
items.summary: Supervised Qwen3-VL-8B checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, released as the start point that online RL initializes from for its ScienceBoard computer-use agent.

items.name: RLG-ALE
items.summary: RLG-ALE evaluates mobile GUI agents on inspectable Android tasks. Its page shows sample episodes with prompts, screenshots, evaluation records, and resettable environments.

items.name: META-GUI dataset
items.summary: Hub release of META-GUI, task-oriented dialogues in which an agent operates mobile apps: each turn pairs the conversation with screenshots, view-hierarchy XML, recorded GUI actions and a reply.

items.name: Coasty
items.summary: Coasty develops computer-use environments for agent training and evaluation, using computer and phone interfaces alongside trajectories and outcome checks.

items.name: RICO-ScreenQA-Short
items.summary: A screen question-answering dataset based on RICO interface images, pairing questions with machine-generated short answers. It provides train, validation and test splits.

items.name: GUI-Net-Mini
items.summary: TongUI training mixture: about 143K samples from WikiHow, Baidu Experience and GUI videos plus reprocessed AITW, AMEX, GUIAct, Mind2Web, MiniWoB and ShowUI data, as grounding and navigation JSON with screenshots.

items.name: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-value-model-16k-qlora-adapter-v2
items.summary: QLoRA adapter for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct that acts as the value model of the WMA web agent, rating world-model predictions of each candidate action's outcome so the agent can choose the top-scored one.

items.name: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-AWQ
items.summary: An AWQ release of the instruction-tuned 7B Qwen2.5-VL model. Its card describes interface-image understanding, visual localization, and computer and phone use.

items.name: Aguvis stage 1 grounding data
items.summary: The first-stage Aguvis training collection, packaging GUI element-grounding annotations and image archives from multiple interface-data sources.

items.name: AGI-0 Agent
items.summary: AGI-0 uses screenshots to navigate Android apps, planning subtasks and checking screen changes after each action. Its publisher reports AndroidWorld results.

items.name: lumos_web_agent_plan_iterative
items.summary: A Lumos-Iterative dataset for training a web agent's planning module, with 1009 Mind2Web task annotations in the described data overview.

items.name: Aria-UI Context-aware Data
items.summary: Episode-based mobile GUI grounding data released with Aria-UI for incorporating interaction history into target localization.

items.name: Claude for Chrome
items.summary: Claude browser extension for interacting with websites.

items.name: Accio Work
items.summary: Agent workspace powered by Alibaba for small-business sourcing, store operations and marketing, whose agents can operate the user's own Chromium browser to navigate, click, type, take screenshots and extract data.

items.name: VG-RL-filter-dataset-hf
items.summary: A dataset released for the second stage of GUI-Spotlight training; its card says the authors used 18.5K samples for that stage.

items.name: Aria-UI context-aware checkpoint
items.summary: The context-aware Aria-UI release that uses interaction context to support grounding in dynamic Android and desktop agent tasks.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) Qwen3.5-9B OSWorld
items.summary: Qwen3.5-9B computer-use agent checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, trained with online RL for OSWorld desktop tasks after an SFT start point and served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.name: CUA Speedrun results
items.summary: Trajectory archives and per-task results from CUA Speedrun evaluations of computer-use models on OSWorld subsets, CUA-World and MyPCBench, with verifier scores, measured task times and recorded or estimated costs.

items.name: InternVL3_5-38B-HF
items.summary: An HF-format 38B checkpoint in the InternVL3.5 multimodal model family, whose card lists GUI interaction among its capabilities and describes staged training and inference.

items.name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-AWQ
items.summary: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-AWQ is an AWQ checkpoint of a vision-language model whose card describes tool-directed computer and phone use and visual localization.

items.name: GUIEnv-local
items.summary: The released local-supervision portion of GUIEnv, pairing webpage regions and text for OCR and GUI grounding.

items.name: VeriOS-Agent-7B
items.summary: A 7B OS agent model that carries out GUI actions under normal conditions and asks a person for input when it detects an untrustworthy scenario, trained in three stages with SFT and GRPO.

items.name: Rico
items.summary: Mobile app screenshots, view hierarchies, and interaction traces for UI research.

items.name: CLM-v0.1-8B
items.summary: Weights for CLM-8B, a contrastive model with state and action heads on a frozen Qwen3-8B encoder that ranks candidate actions; the authors report computer-use, gaming and tool-calling results.

items.name: Fintor/Fintor-GUI-S2
items.summary: Fintor-GUI-S2 is a GUI grounding checkpoint fine-tuned from UI-TARS-7B-DPO on OS-Copilot data. Its card reports ScreenSpot Pro and v2 evaluations.

items.name: GUI-360
items.summary: Desktop GUI trajectory data supporting multiple interface understanding tasks.

items.name: GUI-Owl 1.5 2B Instruct
items.summary: Smallest instruct checkpoint of GUI-Owl 1.5, a Qwen3-VL-based native GUI agent family from Mobile-Agent-v3.5 for desktop, mobile and browser tasks, usable alone or as a role in that framework.

items.name: Simular
items.summary: Computer-use products and research from Simular.

items.name: GUI-Actor 3B Qwen2.5-VL
items.summary: GUI-Actor grounding checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct with an attention-based action head, with about 3.8B BF16 parameters and a config naming a pointer variant of the Qwen2.5-VL class, under MIT.

items.name: GUI-Lasagne L1
items.summary: The published GUI-Lasagne training-data collection used for SpiritSight, distributed as dated archive shards for visual interface learning.

items.name: FluidGPT
items.summary: Android agent product presented through recorded AndroidWorld runs. Fluiz reports completion of 116 tasks across 20 apps through screen interaction.

items.name: Rico Dataset
items.summary: Rico Dataset is a collection of mobile app interaction and design data presented through Interaction Mining, with 70k screens and 10k user flows across 5k apps.

items.name: Holo3.1 35B-A3B
items.summary: 35B-A3B checkpoint of H Company's Holo3.1 family, a sparse mixture-of-experts vision-language model for web, desktop and mobile computer use with native function calling.

items.name: Wave UI
items.summary: Screenshot-instruction records with target boxes and UI metadata such as OCR, source, element type and platform.

data.declared: Wave UI Dataset License; per-image source terms retained

items.name: UIShift-7B-2K
items.summary: UIShift-7B, the initial GUI-Shift model: a Qwen2.5-VL model trained with GRPO on 2K AndroidControl samples to infer which action led from one screenshot to the next.

items.name: aitw-general-digiq-agent
items.summary: Digi-Q agent checkpoint for the AitW General task set: an AutoUI device-control policy trained offline with a learned VLM Q-value function that re-ranks proposed actions.

items.name: DeskMind Eyes 4B
items.summary: DeskMind Eyes 4B maps an element description and screenshot to a click point for Mac applications. The release provides merged model weights and reports GUI grounding results.

items.name: OS-Atlas Data
items.summary: GUI grounding pre-training data for OS-Atlas in desktop (Linux, macOS, Windows), mobile and web domains, with element boxes stored as relative left, top, right and bottom ratios.

items.name: Salesforce Grounding Dataset
items.summary: GUI grounding set that merges Aria-UI, OmniAct, Widget Caption, UI-Vision and OS-Atlas screenshots into target boxes with action, appearance, function and combined instructions, cited to GTA1.

items.name: Cekura
items.summary: Service whose browser agent navigates a customer's SaaS product to check whether its documentation is still accurate, then reports what to fix with summaries, session replays and LLM and browser action traces.

items.name: PSAI computer-use dataset
items.summary: Human computer-use recordings for 3,167 browser and desktop tasks, each with a screen video, input events and reasoning steps, plus screenshots or DOM snapshots for part of the tasks.
aliases: Computer Use Dataset - Paradigm Shift AI

items.name: Mobile-R1 trajectory sample
items.summary: Open sample of Mobile-R1's annotated trajectories on Chinese Android apps: 1,007 tasks whose steps pair a screenshot with a thought, a subtask and a mobile_use action such as click, swipe, type or open.

items.name: WebChain (original release)
items.summary: Original WebChain release of human-annotated trajectories on live websites, with raw JSON records, viewport and partial full-page screenshots, and Parquet files for high-level planning and low-level grounding steps.

items.name: HobbyLM-1B Computer Use
items.summary: An on-device LoRA adapter that turns English requests and Mac state into single actions executed by a companion app, with training code and evaluation records.

items.name: Project Mariner
items.summary: Discontinued Google browser-agent research prototype built with Gemini 2.0 that read screen pixels and page elements and acted in the active Chrome tab through an extension, asking before sensitive actions.

items.name: WebUI
items.summary: Web screenshot and interface data for UI research.

items.name: Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int8
items.summary: A quantized 72B Qwen2-VL checkpoint for visual instruction following. Its model card describes using visual input and text instructions to operate mobile devices.

items.name: PC-Agent-E training data
items.summary: Released dataset used to train PC-Agent-E, linked by the official pipeline for refining human trajectories and synthesizing action reasoning.

items.name: NAIL-Group/ClawBench
items.summary: NAIL-Group/ClawBench releases task data for evaluating browser agents on live websites. Its card describes V1 and V2 corpora, task metadata, and loading through the datasets library.

items.name: VisualWebBench dataset
items.summary: Hugging Face dataset release for VisualWebBench spanning seven visual web understanding, OCR, element grounding, and action prediction tasks.

items.name: WebLINX dataset
items.summary: Hub data of WebLINX 1.0: conversational web-navigation demonstrations preprocessed into per-turn records with dialogue, cleaned HTML, candidate elements and action history, plus reranking data.

items.name: InternVL3_5-8B-HF
items.summary: InternVL3.5-8B multimodal model in Hugging Face Transformers format; its report evaluates the family on GUI grounding and on online agent tasks in OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena and WebArena-Lite-v2.

items.name: Skyvern Cloud
items.summary: Hosted Skyvern service for AI browser workflows such as invoice downloads and form filling, with built-in CAPTCHA and 2FA handling, proxy geotargeting, run explanations and JSON or CSV output.

items.name: Holo4 35B-A3B BF16
items.summary: A Qwen3.6-based computer-use checkpoint designed to request GUI actions, code execution and tool calls through an external agent harness.

items.name: OpenMobile-2 27B
items.summary: Mobile-agent checkpoint based on Qwen3.6-27B for GUI and app-native tool interaction.

items.name: UI-S1 released training examples
items.summary: A public example subset of the UI-S1 mobile training data, packaged as JSONL annotations and Parquet images.

items.name: Holo2 4B
items.summary: A Qwen3-VL-based checkpoint for navigation and multi-step GUI actions across web, desktop and mobile interfaces.

items.name: VeriOS-Bench
items.summary: A dataset for training and evaluating GUI-operating OS agents on decisions to ask a person for help when autonomous action could be unreliable.

items.name: GroundNext-7B-V0
items.summary: GroundNext GUI-grounding checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with SFT then RLOO on GroundCUA desktop data; it maps a screenshot and instruction to a computer_use click call.

items.name: ScreenSpot-v2 instruction variants
items.summary: Instruction variants over ScreenSpot-v2 screenshots that distinguish original commands, explicit actions, target descriptions and impossible operations.

items.name: GUI-Owl 1.5 4B Instruct
items.summary: 4B instruct checkpoint of GUI-Owl 1.5, a Qwen3-VL-based native GUI agent family from Mobile-Agent-v3.5 for desktop, mobile and browser tasks, usable alone or as a role in that framework.

items.name: GLM-4.6V
items.summary: GLM-4.6V is a vision-language model whose release describes screenshot-based tool use and reconstruction and editing of web interfaces from UI images.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) Qwen3-VL-8B OSWorld
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-8B computer-use agent checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, trained with online RL for OSWorld desktop tasks after a released SFT start point.

items.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
items.summary: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is a general model available through an API. Anthropic reports its computer-use performance on OSWorld and demonstrates browser tasks.

items.name: Adept Fuyu-Heavy
items.summary: Adept multimodal model that scales up the Fuyu architecture for digital agents, aimed mainly at UI understanding; Adept reports MMMU, VQAv2, AI2D and ChartQA scores against Gemini models.

items.name: GUI-SD-data
items.summary: Training data for GUI-SD, an on-policy self-distillation method for GUI grounding, with about 6.99k screenshots and a JSONL annotation file read by the GUI-SD training scripts.

items.name: ClawGUI-2B
items.summary: ClawGUI-2B, a 2B mobile GUI agent model trained end to end with the ClawGUI-RL pipeline and GiGPO; the authors report a 17.1 MobileWorld success rate against an 11.1 baseline.

items.name: GT-r1
items.summary: A GUI defect detection model trained with VLM-R1 reinforcement learning that inspects an app screenshot and labels it as a content display error, UI layout issue, missing UI element or no defect.

items.name: Strawberry
items.summary: Agentic desktop browser for macOS and Windows whose AI companions open sites, click through flows and work inside the user's signed-in accounts, asking for approval before sending, paying or deleting.

items.name: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking is a vision-language checkpoint whose card describes recognizing interface elements and using tools to operate PC and mobile GUIs.

items.name: Mano-CUA-2.0-4B
items.summary: A released GUI action model that takes a desktop screenshot and task context to produce structured actions, including clicks, typing, scrolling and app launches.

items.name: AMEX dataset release
items.summary: Official Hub release of AMEX: Android app screenshots annotated for interactive-element grounding, screen and element functionality, and instructions with stepwise GUI-action chains.

items.name: OSWorld 2.0 task classes
items.summary: Gated Hub release of the OSWorld 2.0 benchmark's Python task classes, which hold task setup and evaluator logic kept out of the public code to limit leakage and are pinned per benchmark release.

items.name: UI-S1 7B
items.summary: A mobile GUI checkpoint trained with semi-online reinforcement learning that uses offline trajectories to improve multi-turn action prediction.

items.name: Pix2Struct Screen2Words base
items.summary: Base-size Pix2Struct checkpoint fine-tuned on Screen2Words that writes a short functional summary of a mobile UI screenshot, converted to Transformers from Google's original release.

items.name: Mobile-Bench-v2 released data
items.summary: Offline mobile-agent task data spanning common tasks and released noisy, contaminated and ambiguous-instruction subsets.

items.name: InternVL3-9B
items.summary: A released multimodal checkpoint whose training includes GUI operations and whose card documents GUI grounding alongside broader visual and language tasks.

items.name: Browserless
items.summary: Hosted browser infrastructure for automation applications.

items.name: lumos_web_agent_ground_iterative
items.summary: A Lumos-Iterative dataset for training a web agent's grounding module. Its card identifies 1009 Mind2Web annotations and links to models trained on the data.

items.name: android_control_test
items.summary: android_control_test packages a processed Android Control test set for evaluating the InfiGUI-R1 mobile GUI agent.

items.name: Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ
items.summary: Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ releases quantized weights for a visual instruction model. Its card describes integration with mobile devices for operation guided by images and text.

items.name: WebGenAgent-LM-7B-SFT
items.summary: The 7B supervised fine-tuned checkpoint of WebGen-Agent, which writes website code from instructions and refines it with screenshot critiques and GUI-agent functional tests.

items.name: WildAWM-35B-A3B
items.summary: WildAWM-35B-A3B is a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agent checkpoint post-trained on WildAWM cross-interface computer tasks that mix web, MCP and CLI actions, served text-only with SGLang.

items.name: Uni-GUI-Desktop-1
items.summary: Desktop trajectories from the UI-MOPD training data, collected in OSWorld environments: 2,685 tasks across 10 app categories with step screenshots, reasoning traces, normalized actions and pyautogui code.

items.name: DynamicGUIBench
items.summary: Desktop benchmark of 500 OSWorld-style tasks whose interfaces change between observations through scripted pop-ups, timed edits and shifting lists, with bilingual instructions and end-state evaluators.

items.name: microsoft/Phi-Ground-Any
items.summary: A fine-tuned vision model that takes an image and instruction and returns a click point. Its card specifies image resizing and coordinate conversion.

items.name: ShowUI-web-8K
items.summary: An 8K-sample subset of ShowUI-web with screenshots from varied websites for training GUI grounding models in web interfaces.

items.name: CognitiveKernel-Pro-Query
items.summary: CognitiveKernel-Pro-Query holds the training queries generated for Cognitive Kernel-Pro: multi-hop URLQA and hint-annotated AgentWebQA in JSONL, used to sample web agent trajectories.

items.name: OSWorld Windows VM images
items.summary: Hub host of OSWorld's prebuilt Windows 10 virtual machines: a VMware archive and a QEMU qcow2 archive, which OSWorld's VMware and Docker providers download on first run of a Windows task.

items.name: Seg2Click Qwen2.5-VL 3B
items.summary: Seg2Click checkpoint based on Qwen2.5-VL-3B with a custom action-mask decoder.

items.name: Qwen-GUI checkpoint
items.summary: Qwen-VL checkpoint released with GUICourse and tuned on its GUIAct and GUIChat data; the card's demo draws the box and point coordinates it returns, on a 0–1000 grid, onto the input screenshot.

items.name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking, the 2B reasoning edition of the Qwen3-VL vision-language weights, whose card describes visual-agent operation of PC and mobile GUIs, including element recognition and tool use.

items.name: ChatGPT Atlas
items.summary: OpenAI browser product integrating ChatGPT and agent capabilities.

items.name: WorkDemo-350
items.summary: Desktop demonstrations with task descriptions, videos, input logs, and action-linked screenshot evidence for studying reusable agent skills.

items.name: lumos_web_agent_ground_iterative
items.summary: A released Lumos grounding checkpoint fine-tuned for web-agent tasks using the Lumos-Iterative formulation. It serves the grounding module of a modular agent.

items.name: OpenCSG-Qwen2.5-7B-GUI
items.summary: A browser automation model for the AutoHub plugin that accepts natural-language requests for web operations and information retrieval.

items.name: OpenJev-1.7B
items.summary: OpenJev-1.7B is a local decision model that scores typed options for browser agent steps, including the next operation and target element.

items.name: Webfuse
items.summary: Web augmentation proxy that serves a site inside the user's browser and lets AI agents read DOM, screenshot or accessibility-tree snapshots and click, type or scroll through an automation API and a session MCP server.

items.name: NNetNav WebArena data
items.summary: NNetNav's WebArena-oriented browser-interaction data release, with separate training and test files.

items.name: WikiHow Task Set
items.summary: A Mobile-Env task set for evaluating navigation in the WikiHow app, with supplementary tasks across Android apps. It provides task definitions and rewritten instructions.

items.name: Indeed-UI-8B
items.summary: GUI grounding model fine-tuned from GUI-Owl 1.5-8B with grounding data and high-resolution training; the card reports 73.4 on ScreenSpot-Pro, 94.4 on ScreenSpot-V2 and 68.3 on OSWorld-G.

items.name: OSWorld-Science task data
items.summary: Gated Hub release of OSWorld-Science task definitions, staged inputs, grader references and prepared Ubuntu VM images for computer-use agents working in scientific software.

items.name: Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4
items.summary: A quantized Qwen2-VL vision-language checkpoint for image and video understanding. Its card also describes visual, instruction-guided mobile operation.

items.name: OpenCUA-7B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based computer-use checkpoint that produces desktop actions from screenshots and instructions, using recent screen history for context.

items.name: VideoAgentTrek-IDM-s1-7B
items.summary: Keyframe detection model for the VideoAgentTrek Video2Action pipeline, the first inverse-dynamics stage that finds GUI interaction moments in screen-recorded tutorial videos before a second model labels the actions.

items.name: Aria-UI/Aria-UI-base
items.summary: Aria-UI/Aria-UI-base is a released GUI grounding checkpoint that maps an instruction and interface image to target coordinates. The card documents history-aware input and inference examples.

items.name: Seg2Click Qwen3.5 4B
items.summary: Seg2Click checkpoint pairing a 4B Qwen3.5 backbone with pixel-level action-mask prediction.

items.name: kev-0.6b-browser-use-ONNX
items.summary: A WebGPU-compatible ONNX browser-use model that selects a page element and operation from a goal and candidate elements, with a 4-bit export for JavaScript use.

items.name: EvoCUA 8B 20260105
items.summary: EvoCUA computer-use agent checkpoint (20260105 release) with about 8.8B BF16 parameters in the Qwen3-VL architecture, tagged for OSWorld and for English and Chinese.

items.name: RICO-ScreenAnnotation
items.summary: A standardized Rico screen-annotation dataset pairing mobile screenshots with text about interface elements and their locations. It provides train, validation, and test splits.

items.name: GLM-4.6V-FP8
items.summary: An FP8 multimodal model checkpoint supports tool calls using screenshots as inputs and generates or edits frontend code from images of interfaces.

items.name: AMEX-8K
items.summary: An 8K-sample subset of AMEX with mobile app screenshots for GUI grounding pretraining across varied apps, device forms, and screen densities.

items.name: VideoCAD data
items.summary: CAD screen recordings paired with action logs and target model images for studying precise interface control and long-horizon visual imitation.

items.name: MemGUI-Bench agent trajectories
items.summary: Recorded MemGUI-Bench runs of mobile GUI agents and models, packaged as per-agent ZIP archives with step screenshots, action logs and evaluator outputs, plus compressed trajectory previews for the leaderboard viewer.

items.name: Fanbin/waa_steve_trajectories

items.name: UI-Vision

items.name: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct

items.name: UI-Genie trajectory data

items.name: OS-Genesis 8B AW

items.name: InternVL3_5-30B-A3B-HF
items.summary: Transformers-format InternVL3.5 checkpoint with 30.8B total and 3B active parameters, whose paper reports GUI grounding and online agent results on ScreenSpot, OSWorld-G, WindowsAgentArena and WebArena-Lite-v2.

items.name: OS-Atlas Base 4B

items.name: Dreamer-7B-Shopping

items.name: OS-Genesis web training data
items.summary: Gated OS-Genesis web release holding one JSONL file of reverse-task-synthesis training trajectories and a screenshot archive, named in the project README as training data for its WA checkpoints.

items.name: webagent.cloud
items.summary: Hosted browser-agent service that carries out web tasks from natural-language prompts, billed per second of execution, with a REST API, Make, n8n and Zapier integrations and a self-hostable open-source version.

items.name: DeskForge-Gemma4-E4B

items.name: OpenGVLab/MMBench-GUI

items.name: InternVL3-2B
items.summary: A multimodal model checkpoint whose release documents training on GUI operations and evaluation of GUI grounding alongside broader vision-language tasks.

items.name: ClawBenchV2Trace

items.name: InfiGUI-R1 3B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL checkpoint trained with the Actor2Reasoner procedure to combine interface grounding with planning and recovery reasoning.

items.name: kuangtie/GUI-Robust

items.name: GUI-Owl 1.5 8B Think
items.summary: Thinking variant of the 8B GUI-Owl 1.5 native GUI agent model, built on Qwen3-VL and released with Mobile-Agent-v3.5 for desktop, mobile and browser control, with about 8.8B BF16 parameters under MIT.

items.name: SpiritSight-Agent-2B
items.summary: A 2B vision-based GUI agent checkpoint for interface navigation across GUI platforms, released with an inference script and base-model information.

items.name: GuideBench

items.name: SE-GUI-3k

items.name: Mind2Web data

items.name: Screen2AX-Tree
items.summary: A dataset of macOS application screenshots paired with serialized accessibility trees for training models to reconstruct UI hierarchies from visual input.

items.name: OpenMobile-Data

items.name: ColorGUI-32B

items.name: InfiGUI-G1-3B
items.summary: A GUI grounding checkpoint based on Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct. It uses adaptive exploration training to locate interface elements from an instruction and screen image.

items.name: SCOPE-SFT-9B
items.summary: A Qwen3.5-9B computer-use checkpoint trained on desktop task demonstrations and safety response trajectories, with reported task and attack-avoidance evaluations.

items.summary: Holo2 checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking through supervised and online RL stages for UI element localization and multi-step navigation on web, desktop and mobile interfaces.

items.name: Plan-and-Act Planner 70B
items.summary: The planner component of Plan-and-Act, generating structured high-level plans that an executor turns into web actions.

items.name: AgentQL
items.summary: Web automation tool with a query language and Playwright-based Python and JavaScript SDKs for finding page elements, interacting with sites, and extracting data.

items.name: AGW-35B

items.summary: AgentLab run logs of the A3-Qwen3.5-9B web agent on BrowserGym benchmarks, stored per task as step JSON files with goals, page URLs, DOM and accessibility observations and actions; this address opens the WebArena folder.

items.name: UiPad

items.name: WebTailBench
items.summary: Live-web task definitions and rubrics for evaluating computer-use agents, with preserved original tasks, a refreshed V2 task suite and a separate refusal set.

items.name: FinalRun

items.name: kev-0.6b-browser-use

items.name: cua-s1-nano-0.1
items.summary: A small computer-use classifier that scores predefined GUI element-action options from accessibility text or screenshot crops in one parallel pass.

items.name: KNOWS Benchmark
items.summary: KNOWS provides 110 web-agent task prompts and grading rubrics for creating documents, spreadsheets, and slides in Google Workspace.

items.name: GUI-Vid
items.summary: GUI-Vid is a released video language model retrained on GUI-World for understanding graphical interfaces in video.

items.name: Claude Computer Use
items.summary: Claude tool capability for screenshot-based computer interaction.

items.name: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-WM-webarena-16k-adapter
items.summary: PEFT world-model adapter for Llama 3.1 8B Instruct from the WMA web agent project, trained to describe the state changes an action causes so the agent can choose actions on WebArena.

items.name: Halluminate/WebBench
items.summary: Halluminate/WebBench releases task data for evaluating browser agents on read, create, update, delete, and file workflows across live websites.

items.name: Web Browser Automation with Agents (smolagents tutorial)
items.summary: Versioned tutorial building a vision-guided CodeAgent with Selenium/Helium browser tools, screenshot callbacks and example web-navigation tasks.

items.name: AgentSynth tasks and trajectories
items.summary: Published AgentSynth task definitions and recorded GUI trajectories, with OSWorld and InSTA training configurations and packaged screenshots, thoughts and commands.

items.name: UIX-Qwen2-Mind2Web
items.summary: UIX-Qwen2 further fine-tuned on the Mind2Web training set; the MultiUI paper evaluates it on predicting the next web action from a screenshot, the task and previous actions.

items.name: LocateAnything-3B
items.summary: LocateAnything-3B is a 3B vision-language grounding model that predicts full bounding boxes in parallel, covering GUI element grounding alongside object detection, documents and OCR.

items.name: Computer Use Trajectories (markov-ai)
items.summary: 160 successful OSWorld trajectories (1,378 steps) by a Gemini 3 Flash Preview agent with accessibility-tree grounding, with per-step screenshots, accessibility trees, pyautogui actions, responses and run logs.

items.name: Twin
items.summary: No-code platform that turns plain-language goals into scheduled business agents, calling APIs where they exist and falling back to a Web Agent that clicks, types and fills forms in an isolated cloud browser.

items.name: Starizon AI
items.summary: Chrome side-panel agent that researches across tabs, bookmarks and a local knowledge base, and hands click-and-type tasks on signed-in sites to its Agent S6 browser agent, with replays, schedules and page monitors.

items.name: navi-bench
items.summary: Task data for Navi-Bench, everyday web tasks on live websites: a 200-row validation split over ten sites such as Apartments, Craigslist and Google Flights, each with a task-generation config, domain and categories.

items.name: PAE LLaVA 7B
items.summary: A released LLaVA checkpoint for visual browser interaction from the PAE autonomous task-proposal and policy-learning system.

items.name: yolov11l-ui-elements-detection
items.summary: A YOLO11 fine-tune that locates five kinds of interface elements in macOS application screenshots to support accessibility metadata generation.

items.name: GUI-Actor-3B-Qwen2.5-VL-LiteTrain
items.summary: A GUI-grounding checkpoint built on Qwen2.5-VL-3B with an attention-based action head. Given a screenshot and instruction, it predicts a click location.

items.name: WebClick
items.summary: A web-interface localization benchmark with screenshot instructions and target boxes, including agent browsing, human browsing and calendar cases.

items.name: NeurIPS 2025: 45 Computer-Use Agent Papers You Should Know About
items.summary: An annotated reading list of 45 NeurIPS 2025 computer-use agent papers, organized around benchmarks, safety, grounding and agent architectures.

items.name: MirrorGuard checkpoint
items.summary: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct fine-tune that reads an instruction, history, screenshot and a computer-use agent's thought, returns the thought unchanged when safe and rewrites or refuses it when risky.

items.name: GUI-Odyssey — original OpenGVLab release
items.summary: Original Hub upload of GUI Odyssey: 7,735 cross-app Android navigation episodes from six emulated devices with per-step screenshots, actions and four split files, which the card says is superseded.

items.name: EvoCUA 32B 20260105
items.summary: Larger EvoCUA computer-use agent checkpoint (20260105 release) with about 33B BF16 parameters in the Qwen3-VL architecture, tagged for OSWorld and for English and Chinese.

items.name: YOLOv11l — UI Groups Detection
items.summary: A YOLO11 fine-tune that detects UI groups such as toolbars and tab groups in macOS application screenshots for accessibility analysis.

items.name: UI-Venus 2 9B
items.summary: UI-Venus 2 GUI-agent checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-9B, with about 9.4B BF16 parameters in the Qwen3.5 multimodal architecture, loaded through Transformers for image-text-to-text.

items.name: GUIGuard-Bench public-ladder release
items.summary: Public-ladder release of GUIGuard-Bench: 121 Android and Linux desktop agent trajectories whose 2,002 screenshots carry region-level privacy labels, for privacy recognition, protected-screen planning and click grounding.

items.name: GUI-R1 checkpoint bundle
items.summary: A single Hub release containing GUI-R1 3B and 7B action-model checkpoints trained with reinforcement learning across interface platforms.

items.name: Agent-Trajectories
items.summary: An archive dataset of evaluated web, Android, and iOS agent trajectories, including iOS emulator runs and WebArena runs used for agent refinement.

items.name: LPS-Bench
items.summary: A dataset for evaluating safety across computer-use agent trajectories, with 570 base cases and 40 skill variants covering benign and adversarial tasks.

items.name: SEAgent-1.0-7B
items.summary: Computer-use agent checkpoint from SEAgent, built on UI-TARS-7B-DPO and trained by experiential learning on self-generated OSWorld software tasks; the paper reports 34.5% success on five novel applications.

items.name: WebVIA-Agent
items.summary: GLM-4.1V-9B-based web exploration agent from WebVIA that reads a page screenshot and DOM tree and picks click, type or select actions to reach each interactive UI state for UI-to-code work.

items.name: Microscopy-Dataset
items.summary: Task set for the Orion computer-using agent's microscopy image-processing task: 12 CellProfiler training modules and 14 test challenges with problem statements, images, ground truth and unit tests.

items.name: UI-Ins-7B
items.summary: UI-Ins-7B is a GUI-grounding checkpoint trained on varied instruction formulations and reinforcement learning to locate interface elements for agent actions.

items.name: cua-ai/cua-s1-forms
items.summary: Training and evaluation examples for selecting GUI form actions from document content, with synthetic train, validation, and test splits plus real browser form demos.

items.name: AutoBrowser
items.summary: Chrome side-panel extension that runs a browser-use-style web agent: it indexes a tab's interactive elements and has a user-configured OpenAI-compatible model open tabs, click, type and press keys.

items.name: ScaleCUA Data
items.summary: Cross-platform training data released with ScaleCUA, with grounding and navigation annotations for Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, Android, iPhone and web screenshots.

items.name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
items.summary: A Claude release with an optional extended-thinking mode. Anthropic describes its mouse and keyboard computer-use capability and reports OSWorld evaluation results.

items.name: GUI-AIMA-3B
items.summary: GUI grounding model that predicts click locations from attention between a learnable ANCHOR token and visual patches, extra-trained on 250k GroundCUA samples; the authors report 61.5% on ScreenSpot-Pro with 2-step zoom.

items.name: Scribe
items.summary: Workflow recording and documentation product adjacent to agent data collection.

items.name: KDEGroup/UI-AGILE-3B
items.summary: A released UI-AGILE checkpoint for GUI grounding, associated with reward design and cropping based resampling during training and image decomposition during inference.

items.name: cogagent-vqa-hf
items.summary: A CogAgent checkpoint oriented toward single-turn visual dialogue; its card also describes GUI screenshot understanding, coordinate actions, and reported GUI dataset results.

items.name: ASIL Benchmark Images
items.summary: Prebuilt Singularity/Apptainer runtime images for reproducing the ASIL agent benchmark, supplied with versioned manifests and checksums.

items.name: webgames
items.summary: Task list for WebGames, a set of client-side web challenges for browsing agents: one JSONL file giving each task's id, title, description, page path, success password and tags.

items.name: Komos
items.summary: Hosted automation platform whose task flows use a prompt-driven agent to navigate, click, type and extract on websites in a cloud Chromium sandbox or self-hosted runner, built from narrated screen recordings or chat.

items.name: GUI-Actor data
items.summary: A processed screenshot and bounding-box collection released for training GUI-Actor visual grounding models.

items.name: OpenMobile-8B
items.summary: Mobile agent checkpoint with a Qwen3-VL architecture, released with OpenMobile and fine-tuned on its synthesized Android trajectories; the code README serves it with vLLM for AndroidWorld evaluation.

items.name: STEVE-R1-7B-SFT
items.summary: STEVE-R1-7B-SFT is a released computer-use checkpoint trained with step-verified data for desktop agent tasks and evaluated on Windows and Ubuntu environments.

items.name: Screen2AX-Group
items.summary: A dataset of macOS application screenshots with bounding boxes and UI group labels for training and evaluating interface object detection models.

items.name: GUI-Libra 8B
items.summary: GUI-Libra checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (about 8.77B BF16 parameters) that turns a screenshot, task and action history into a <thinking> reasoning block and a JSON action with point_2d coordinates.

items.name: Uni-GUI-OpenMobile
items.summary: Android trajectories on 19 open-source apps from the UI-MOPD training data, collected via AndroidWorld: 2,640 tasks with step screenshots, reasoning traces and normalized click, swipe, type and answer actions.

items.name: AndroidGen-GLM-4-9B
items.summary: AndroidGen-GLM-4-9B is a released model for agents that carry out tasks across Android apps without manually labeled interaction data.

items.name: Multimodal-Mind2Web
items.summary: Mind2Web action steps aligned with the matching webpage screenshot, plus raw and cleaned HTML, candidate elements and the target operation, in a train split and test splits held out by task, website and domain.

items.name: PixelWeb
items.summary: PixelWeb releases webpage screenshots, DOM data and element images with masks, contours and boxes in 1K, 10K and 100K collections.

items.name: WebsiteBench
items.summary: Hugging Face copy of the 70 WebsiteBench tasks in Harbor format, where agents explore a production-level reference website in a browser and rebuild a full-stack clone scored by hidden functional and visual tests.

items.name: Gumloop
items.summary: Business agent platform whose agents work through app connectors and can turn on a Chromium browser that clicks, types, signs in with saved logins and hands control to a person when a site needs it.

items.name: dart-gui-7b
items.summary: GUI agent checkpoint released with DART, a decoupled asynchronous RL framework that separates environments, rollout, data management and training; the paper reports 42.13% task success on OSWorld.

items.name: Narada Operator
items.summary: Narada Operator is an enterprise web agent that executes workflows across web interfaces and APIs using task planning and error recovery.

items.name: HyperWrite Personal Assistant
items.summary: Browser agent from HyperWrite that carries out typed requests such as searching, making reservations and filling out forms by operating the user's Chrome browser through the HyperWrite extension.

items.name: GTA1-7B-2507
items.summary: GTA1-7B-2507 is a GUI-grounding checkpoint trained with reinforcement learning to locate described elements in screenshots and return click coordinates.

items.name: Anchor Browser
items.summary: Anchor Browser provides cloud browser sessions for agents through SDK, CDP and REST interfaces. Its documentation describes natural-language tasks, authentication and reusable workflows.

items.name: AskUI
items.summary: Agentic test-automation platform running plain-language test cases from pixels on desktop apps, Citrix, in-car head units and mobile devices, deployable on-premise or air-gapped.

items.name: WeaveBench
items.summary: Computer-use benchmark mixing graphical interaction and code execution.

items.name: GUI-Owl 1.5 32B Instruct
items.summary: Instruct variant of the 32B GUI-Owl 1.5 native GUI agent model, built on Qwen3-VL and released with Mobile-Agent-v3.5 for desktop, mobile and browser control, with about 33.4B BF16 parameters under MIT.

items.name: CUA-Gym
items.summary: Computer-use environment and task resources for agent research.

items.name: Pathology-Dataset
items.summary: Task set for the Orion computer-using agent's digital pathology task in QuPath: tutorial material, lymph-node metastasis segmentation on CAMELYON slides and TP53 index calculation, with test suites.

items.name: ShowUI-Narrator
items.summary: A released 2B model for narrating user actions in GUI screenshots and video, with a pipeline that detects the cursor and processes cropped frames.

items.name: OmniJev
items.summary: OmniJev v1.1 is a 4B LoRA adapter with decision heads for Qwen3.5-4B that answers typed questions about screens and other images with probabilities; its task families include androidcontrol and web.

items.name: Holotron-12B
items.summary: Computer-use policy checkpoint from H Company and NVIDIA, fine-tuned from Nemotron Nano 12B v2 VL on localization and navigation data, with a hybrid SSM-attention backbone for high-throughput multi-image inference.

items.name: Pix2Struct Screen2Words large
items.summary: Large-size Pix2Struct checkpoint fine-tuned on Screen2Words that writes a short functional summary of a mobile UI screenshot, converted to Transformers from Google's original release.

items.name: GUIAct
items.summary: Web and Android GUI action-instruction data, with single-step, multi-step and smartphone partitions.

items.name: inclusionAI/UI-Venus-Navi-7B
items.summary: A released UI agent checkpoint based on Qwen2.5-VL that takes screenshots and prior actions to predict GUI navigation actions and element locations.

items.name: InternVL3-1B
items.summary: InternVL3-1B is a multimodal model whose training includes GUI operation examples; its model card also presents a GUI grounding evaluation.

items.name: SE-GUI-3B
items.summary: GUI grounding model on a Qwen2.5-VL 3B backbone trained with self-evolutionary reinforcement fine-tuning on 3,018 curated samples; the authors report 35.9 on ScreenSpot-Pro.

items.name: UI-Genie Agent 7B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL mobile action model trained using existing and reward-guided synthetic trajectories from the UI-Genie framework.

items.name: ZeroGUI-OSWorld-7B
items.summary: A GUI agent checkpoint associated with ZeroGUI, which trains on generated interface tasks using rewards estimated from trajectory screenshots.

items.name: Qwen3.5-4B-Browser-Agent-SFT-FP8
items.summary: An FP8 Qwen3.5-4B checkpoint fine-tuned on browser-agent trajectories with structured actions. Its card provides vLLM serving settings and reports BrowseWebApp-Bench v2 results.

items.name: InternVL3-78B
items.summary: InternVL3-78B is a released multimodal checkpoint whose model-family card describes GUI-operation training data and a GUI-grounding evaluation alongside broader vision-language tasks.

items.name: KV-Ground-4B-BaseGuiOwl1.5-0228
items.summary: A 4B vision-language checkpoint for locating GUI targets in high-resolution images. It is fine-tuned from GUI-Owl-1.5-4B-Instruct with supervised and reward-based post-training.

items.name: Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct
items.summary: Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct is a general vision-language model whose card describes operation of mobile devices from visual input and instructions and reports Android agent evaluations.

items.name: cua-s1-forms
items.summary: A 706,048-parameter checkpoint that scores candidate actions for GUI form fields in parallel. It is released as safetensors weights with a configuration file.

items.name: pae-data
items.summary: pae-data releases data associated with PAE research on internet agents, including task files for WebArena and WebVoyager and model checkpoint files.

items.name: OpenWebVoyager/OpenWebVoyager-IL
items.summary: An Idefics2-based multimodal web-agent checkpoint trained by imitation learning on trajectories collected with a web-agent framework.

items.name: RICO-SCA
items.summary: A mobile UI dataset pairing screenshots and widget boxes with synthetic captions and view hierarchy data for screen understanding and interface grounding.

items.name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-UI-R1-E
items.summary: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-UI-R1-E releases UI-R1-E-3B, a model that predicts click coordinates from interface screenshots and commands, with reported mobile, desktop, and web grounding evaluations.

items.name: WebShepherd 3B
items.summary: A public text-based process-reward checkpoint from the Web-Shepherd collection for scoring web-agent decisions against task checklists.

items.name: MiniCPM-GUIDance
items.summary: MiniCPM-V checkpoint released with GUICourse and tuned on its GUIEnv, GUIAct and GUIChat data; card prompts cover next-action generation from a task and action history, and screenshot chat with grounded boxes.

items.name: FluidGPT
items.summary: An Android agent that selects reusable app routines from a task goal and executes them through the accessibility tree. Its benchmark report presents episode recordings and action traces.

items.name: SATraj-OS
items.summary: Desktop computer-use trajectories with per-step screenshots and success, safety and attack labels, split into capability runs, safe-completion and refusal runs, and a legacy RiOSWorld-derived safety archive.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) Qwen3-VL-8B ScienceBoard
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-8B computer-use agent checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, trained with online RL for ScienceBoard scientific-software tasks after an SFT start point and served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.name: agent-qa
items.summary: A QA agent that runs plain-language tests against web, Android, and iOS apps. It navigates user flows, verifies outcomes, and stores validated run evidence for reuse.

items.name: Seg2Click Qwen3.5 0.8B
items.summary: Compact Seg2Click checkpoint with a merged Qwen3.5 backbone and an action-mask decoder.

items.name: Anchor
items.summary: Anchor provides cloud browser environments for AI agents to navigate authenticated websites and run browser workloads, with SDK and MCP integration.

items.name: OpenAI CUA
items.summary: Computer-using model introduced with the Operator research preview.

items.name: Orienter
items.summary: Orienter locates interactable elements in extended reality interface screenshots using application context and a detector. The release includes code and a checkpoint.

items.name: ScienceBoard VMware environment
items.summary: A prebuilt Ubuntu virtual-machine archive containing the software environment used for ScienceBoard scientific computer-use tasks.

items.name: ConClick-8B
items.summary: A GUI grounding checkpoint trained to distinguish target elements from distractors using coordinate and ranking supervision, released as an adapter and supporting weights.

items.name: Jedi-7B-1080p
items.summary: A released model checkpoint for computer-use grounding research, based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. The repository includes weight shards and tokenizer files.

items.name: AndroidGen-Llama-3-70B
items.summary: AndroidGen-Llama-3-70B is a released model for agents that carry out tasks across Android applications such as messaging, email and settings without manually labeled interaction data.

items.name: Gelato-UI-TARS-1.5-7B
items.summary: UI-TARS-1.5-7B trained with reinforcement learning on the Click-100k dataset for 255 steps as the Gelato recipe baseline for GUI grounding. The authors report gains over GTA1-7B-2507 on ScreenSpot-Pro and OS-World-G.

items.name: Holotron4 30B-A3B
items.summary: NemotronH Nano Omni-based computer-use checkpoint in H Company's Holo4 family; an external harness sends it screenshots and tool results and executes the clicks, typing, code and tool calls it requests.

items.name: Muse-Glimmer-30B-GUI-Grounding-Fast
items.summary: A LoRA adapter for Muse-Glimmer-30B that returns a UI element's bounding box from a screenshot and instruction, with examples spanning desktop, mobile, and web screens.

items.name: Dex
items.summary: ThirdLayer's Chrome extension that keeps an operational memory of a user's work tools and runs agents that navigate tabs and fill forms in the browser, alongside Gmail, Slack and CRM integrations.

items.name: OpenCUA-7B-exl2
items.summary: OpenCUA-7B-exl2 is a 4.5bpw quantized OpenCUA-7B checkpoint for generating computer actions and locating GUI targets from screenshots.

items.name: WebJudge 7B
items.summary: A visual trajectory judge that retains selected intermediate screenshots to evaluate whether a web agent completed its task.

items.name: WebLINX 1.1 (WebLINX-BrowserGym)
items.summary: WebLINX 1.1, a reprocessed release of WebLINX's conversational web-navigation demonstrations packaged as single-step BrowserGym tasks that score one predicted browser action against the recorded turn.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) GLM-4.6V-Flash OSWorld
items.summary: GLM-4.6V-Flash computer-use agent checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, trained with online RL for OSWorld desktop tasks after an SFT start point and served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.name: gWorld-8B
items.summary: gWorld-8B is a released mobile GUI world model that predicts the screen after an action by generating renderable HTML from the current screenshot and action.

items.name: VideoCUA
items.summary: Expert desktop computer-use demonstrations from CUA-Suite: 30 fps screen recordings with millisecond-timestamped mouse and keyboard action logs for about 10K tasks in 87 applications.

items.name: AutoGUI v1 training data
items.summary: Screenshot-based grounding and captioning samples with UI functionality descriptions, target coordinates, and bounding boxes.

items.name: ExACT-VWA
items.summary: Post-processed R-MCTS and GPT-4o agent trajectories collected on VisualWebArena, stored as context and response pairs with domain and task metadata; part of the set was used to fine-tune GPT-4o.

items.name: WinDeskGround_windows
items.summary: WinDeskGround_windows supplies Windows application screenshots with clickable targets, bounding boxes, and referring expressions for desktop GUI grounding tasks.

items.name: Process Discovery
items.summary: An enterprise process-discovery product that captures activity across desktops and web apps, then maps workflows to identify patterns and automation opportunities.

items.name: Ace
items.summary: General Agents' desktop autopilot, trained on recorded expert behavior, that predicts clicks, keystrokes and other actions from screenshots; its API client ships a macOS controller that executes them.

items.name: ScreenSpot
items.summary: GUI grounding test set of 1,272 screenshot instructions from iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and web interfaces, each labeled with the target element's bounding box.

items.name: BrowserAct
items.summary: Managed web scraping platform with reusable browser interaction workflows.

items.name: OS-Genesis 7B AW
items.summary: The AndroidWorld-oriented Qwen2-VL checkpoint trained on mobile trajectories generated through OS-Genesis reverse task synthesis, predicting the next thought and action from an instruction, history and screen.

items.name: InternVL3-8B
items.summary: An 8B multimodal checkpoint whose release describes GUI-operation training data and a GUI-grounding evaluation alongside broader image and video tasks.

items.name: Llama-3-8B-Web
items.summary: A Llama 3 8B instruction-model checkpoint fine-tuned on WebLINX web interactions and dialogue, predicting browser actions from a textual state representation.

items.name: CognitiveKernel-Pro-SFT
items.summary: CognitiveKernel-Pro-SFT contains rejection-sampled GPT-4.1 trajectories for fine-tuning Cognitive Kernel-Pro agents, from URLQA web queries, DocBench, TableBench and a WebWalkerQA subset.

items.name: HARPA AI
items.summary: Chrome extension that brings chat models to any web page for summaries and writing, with an automation engine whose user-built commands navigate, click, paste, extract and monitor pages around AI steps.

items.name: UI-R1 3B training data
items.summary: The released mobile training subset for the original UI-R1 3B model, with action annotations and individual screenshot files.

items.name: InternVL3_5-241B-A28B-HF
items.summary: InternVL3_5-241B-A28B-HF releases a Transformers-format multimodal checkpoint from the InternVL3.5 family, whose card describes GUI interaction and efficient visual inference.

items.name: Co-Design Bench
items.summary: Co-Design Bench evaluates application revisions from multimodal requests using 96 editing tasks with annotated screenshots and 521 criteria checked against source and browser evidence.

items.name: WebThinker-R1-14B
items.summary: WebThinker-R1-14B is a released reasoning model whose card describes web search, page exploration through clicks, and report drafting during research tasks.

items.name: orion-vm-arm
items.summary: A VMware Fusion snapshot of the Orion agent's Ubuntu guest for arm64 Macs, with CellProfiler, QuPath and napari pre-installed, released as a single OS.zip archive.

items.name: lumos_web_agent_plan_iterative-13B
items.summary: A released Lumos checkpoint for planning web-agent tasks within an iterative architecture that separates planning, grounding and execution.

items.name: UGround-V1-72B
items.summary: UGround-V1-72B is a Qwen2-VL-based model for locating targets in GUI screenshots, released with weights and reported evaluations on mobile, desktop, and web screens.

items.name: WebGenAgent-LM-8B-Step-GRPO
items.summary: The 8B Step-GRPO checkpoint of WebGen-Agent, which writes website code from instructions; training used screenshot scores and GUI-agent test scores as step-level rewards.

items.name: GUI-Perturbed
items.summary: Step-level web grounding benchmark that re-renders Mind2Web pages with style, zoom and text-size perturbations and pairs each screenshot with a direct or relational instruction and a target box.

items.name: AutoGUI-Qwen-v0.1
items.summary: A UI vision-language model checkpoint trained on AutoGUI-625k data and fine-tuned from Qwen-VL-Chat for interpreting interfaces.

items.name: InternVL3_5-8B
items.summary: An 8B multimodal checkpoint in the InternVL3.5 family, whose card describes GUI interaction alongside broader visual reasoning and inference efficiency work.

items.name: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct
items.summary: A Qwen3-VL vision-language checkpoint whose model card describes PC and mobile GUI operation, including element recognition, tool use and task completion.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) GLM-4.6V-Flash ScienceBoard SFT
items.summary: Supervised GLM-4.6V-Flash checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, released as the start point that online RL initializes from for its ScienceBoard computer-use agent.

items.name: Copilot Studio computer use
items.summary: Copilot Studio agent tool that operates websites and Windows desktop apps on a configured machine through a computer-using model, with stored credentials, site and app allow lists and human supervision.
aliases: Computer use in Microsoft Copilot Studio

items.name: WebThinker-R1-32B
items.summary: Released reasoning checkpoint for web research that searches and navigates pages through interactive clicks while drafting reports from gathered information.

items.name: OS-Genesis 4B WA
items.summary: The WebArena-oriented InternVL2-4B checkpoint trained on web trajectories generated through OS-Genesis reverse task synthesis, predicting the next thought and action from an instruction, history and page.

items.name: OS-Genesis 7B AC
items.summary: The AndroidControl-oriented Qwen2-VL checkpoint trained with mobile trajectories generated through OS-Genesis reverse task synthesis.

items.name: TurkingBench
items.summary: A web-agent benchmark built from crowdsourcing HTML tasks, with 32.2K instances across 158 tasks and a framework that applies model responses to page controls.

items.name: Kirk Engine
items.summary: An Android agent that uses screenshots and accessibility trees to choose taps, typing and swipes. Its page reports an AndroidWorld run and describes per-task verification artifacts.

items.name: UI-Venus-Navi-72B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based UI checkpoint for predicting navigation actions and locating interface elements from screenshots, trained with reinforcement fine-tuning.

items.name: Seg2Click Qwen3.5 9B
items.summary: Seg2Click checkpoint pairing a 9B Qwen3.5 backbone with a decoder for valid GUI click regions.

items.name: OS-Atlas Base 7B
items.summary: OS-Atlas base checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct, using the standard Qwen2-VL architecture in Transformers with about 8.3B BF16 parameters.

items.name: V-Droid-8B-0323
items.summary: A verifier model for the V-Droid Android GUI agent scores candidate actions from a device description and task, helping select the next mobile operation.

items.name: OpenPhone_model
items.summary: OpenPhone-3B weights, a 3B on-device model for Android GUI tasks trained with supervised fine-tuning on synthetic reasoning data and then GRPO-style reinforcement learning.

items.name: VeriGUI
items.summary: VeriWeb dataset of 302 web information-seeking tasks, with annotated subtasks, human action logs, and execution videos for evaluating long-chain agents.

items.name: Hronaut
items.summary: A local browser workspace for agents, exposed through MCP. It supports isolated task sessions, visible browser use and reconnection to existing tabs.

items.name: OmniAct
items.summary: Dataset and benchmark for generating computer interaction programs.

items.name: UI-Genie reward data
items.summary: Mobile GUI reward annotations released for training UI-Genie’s trajectory-assessment model.

items.name: Seg2Click
items.summary: A hosted GUI grounding demo that takes a screenshot and instruction, then predicts an action mask and click point using a public Seg2Click checkpoint.

items.name: AgentEval
