items.name: BearCubs
items.summary: A live-web benchmark with 111 questions testing agents' ability to browse and extract factual answers through text and multimodal interactions.

items.name: showdown-clicks
items.summary: Offline click benchmark from General Agents: 557 human left clicks on macOS screenshots, each with an instruction and the bounding box of valid click locations, scored by whether a predicted point lands inside.

items.name: AgentRewardBench dataset
items.summary: Hugging Face dataset release for AgentRewardBench containing trajectory evaluation instances across WebArena, VisualWebArena, AssistantBench, WorkArena, and OSWorld.

items.name: AndroidDaily
items.summary: Android GUI benchmark dataset from Step-GUI containing 3,146 static action evaluation items and 235 end-to-end daily mobile tasks.

items.name: FedMABench data partitions
items.summary: Six families of JSONL partitions of AndroidControl and AitW mobile-agent episodes for FedMABench federated training under app, category and step/episode heterogeneity; screenshots must be rebuilt from the sources.

items.name: OpAgent-32B
items.summary: A vision-language model fine-tuned for web navigation. It takes a task instruction and webpage screenshot and produces a browser action or final answer.

items.name: Gemini Computer Use
items.summary: Gemini capability for generating interface actions from screenshots.

items.name: lumos_unified_ground_iterative
items.summary: A JSONL training dataset for the Lumos-I grounding module, combining math, question-answering, and web-agent annotations, including examples from Mind2Web.

items.name: Bardeen
items.summary: Chrome-extension platform for go-to-market teams whose AI scraper navigates sites, clicks, fills forms and pages through results to collect leads, with an AI template builder and a goal-driven agent mode.

items.name: WenyiWU0111/CoMEM-agent-memory-trajectories
items.summary: A dataset for GUI-agent memory research containing expanded web links, synthesized tasks, and executed trajectories with successful and failed outcomes.

items.name: GPA-GUI-Detector
items.summary: GPA-GUI-Detector is a YOLO model that locates interactive elements such as buttons and icons in interface screenshots and returns bounding boxes for automation workflows.

items.name: BlenderWorld
items.summary: A benchmark of 223 Blender creation tasks with text, image, and video inputs. Agents submit editable projects for rendering and rubric-based evaluation.

items.name: AgentQL
items.summary: Natural-language querying and interaction tools for web interfaces.

items.name: ShowUI-web
items.summary: Web-interface grounding examples with instructions, element boxes and points, paired with a separately packaged screenshot archive.

items.name: WinDeskGround
items.summary: Benchmark data for GUI grounding on synthesized multi-window desktops: 1356 samples over 585 images, with controlled occlusion, semantic distraction and clutter plus difficulty levels L1 to L5.

items.name: Plan-and-Act Actor 70B
items.summary: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-based executor checkpoint from the Plan-and-Act web-agent framework that translates high-level plans into browser actions.

items.name: lora_qformer_test_V4-700_merged
items.summary: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct merged with the CoMEM memory module, which compresses past GUI trajectories into 8 continuous embeddings through a LoRA-tuned Q-Former, for web agent tasks.

items.name: TimeWarp
items.summary: Dataset of 231 web-agent goals for Wiki, News, and Shop sites across six interface eras, with train and test splits and evaluator specifications.

items.name: ScreenParser
items.summary: YOLO11-L UI element detector from IBM Research and ETH Zurich that boxes and labels 55 element classes in web screenshots; the main checkpoint is trained on ScreenParse v2 and the v1 detector stays on a branch.

items.name: GUI-Net-1M
items.summary: A TongUI-collected training corpus from multimodal web tutorials, distributed as annotation files and split screenshot archives for GUI trajectory supervision.

items.name: MultiUI training data
items.summary: Gated Hub release of the MultiUI web-UI training data, about 7.3 million samples per the project README, packaged as two training-stage JSON files and 21 split TAR archive parts.

items.name: OmniJev-0.8B
items.summary: OmniJev decision adapter for Qwen3.5-0.8B: LoRA weights and heads that return probabilities for typed questions about screens, video and robot scenes, evaluated on web and phone task families.

items.name: UGround-V1-8k
items.summary: UGround-V1-8k supplies an 8K-sample subset of web interface screenshots for GUI grounding pretraining across varied resolutions and aspect ratios.

items.name: WebPRM Collection preference data
items.summary: Checklist-annotated web decision records with page observations, prior actions, one preferred continuation and rejected alternatives for process-reward learning.

items.name: AgentCPM-GUI 8B checkpoint
items.summary: An eight-billion-parameter MiniCPM-V-based model that consumes smartphone screenshots and predicts compact actions for Chinese and English Android app tasks.

items.name: OpenJev-8B
items.summary: OpenJev-8B is a local decision model that scores typed options for browser agent operations and target elements in a single forward pass.

items.name: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct
items.summary: A Qwen3-VL vision-language checkpoint whose card describes visual-agent operation of PC and mobile GUIs, including element recognition and tool use.

items.name: Cie1/MMSearch-Plus
items.summary: A dataset of 311 image-based tasks for evaluating multimodal browsing agents that use iterative image and text retrieval to answer questions.

items.name: GUI-Libra 4B
items.summary: GUI-Libra checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (about 4.83B BF16 parameters) that turns a screenshot, task and action history into a <thinking> reasoning block and a JSON action with point_2d coordinates.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct is a vision-language checkpoint whose card describes PC and mobile GUI operation, including element recognition and tool calls.

items.name: Holo3.1 4B
items.summary: 4B checkpoint of H Company's Holo3.1 family, a vision-language model for web, desktop and mobile computer-use agents with native function calling, built on a dense Qwen3.5 architecture.

items.name: GUI-G2 7B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL grounding checkpoint trained with Gaussian point and coverage rewards whose granularity adapts to interface-element scale.

items.name: OSWorld-V2 0624 Codex attempt trajectories
items.summary: Self-reported OSWorld-V2 run of a Codex-based harness with gpt-5.6-sol on all 108 tasks: per-step CLI and GUI actions, screenshots and scores, plus retried attempts and the solution and recovery cards that guided them.

items.name: Huzzle Labs
items.summary: Company developing computer-use models, RL environments and evaluations for AI labs and enterprise work. Its site describes the Huzzle World model family.

items.name: AgentGym-RL-Data-ID
items.summary: Train and eval task splits for AgentGym-RL multi-turn reinforcement learning, listing task IDs for WebArena web navigation alongside search, game, embodied and science environments.

items.name: SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct-Agentic-GUI
items.summary: SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct fine-tuned in two phases on the aguvis-stage-1 and aguvis-stage-2 datasets to locate screen elements and emit GUI actions as function calls. The authors report 61% on ScreenSpot-v2.

items.name: FunUI-Benchmark
items.summary: FunUI is a Chinese-English benchmark built on 2,150 Chinese and 9,347 English Android screens, testing UI grounding, UI referring, screen question answering and screen summarization.

items.name: JUMPDiscovery
items.summary: Task data for the Orion computer-using agent's open discovery task: a problem statement, CellProfiler pipelines, gene sets and a script that downloads JUMP Cell Painting morphological profiles.

items.name: ScreenAgent
items.summary: ScreenAgent-2312 weights in SAT format, a CogAgent-based vision-language model that drives the ScreenAgent environment, issuing mouse and keyboard actions over VNC in plan, act and reflect stages.

items.name: PhoneHarness Bench
items.summary: Task definitions and verifier metadata for 124 mixed-action Android phone tasks and 30 safety tasks, where agents may act through app GUIs, device commands and MCP-style tools.

items.name: Claude Code
items.summary: Anthropic agentic coding tool for terminal, IDE, desktop and web, with an opt-in computer-use preview that screenshots and operates approved apps on macOS (CLI) and on macOS and Windows (Desktop).

items.name: Uni-GUI-Mobile
items.summary: Self-collected phone trajectories from the UI-MOPD training data: 871 tasks across 10 app categories, each with step screenshots, reasoning traces, normalized tap, swipe and type actions, and adb commands.

items.name: OS-Genesis 7B WA
items.summary: The WebArena-oriented Qwen2-VL-7B checkpoint trained on web trajectories generated through OS-Genesis reverse task synthesis, predicting the next thought and action from an instruction, history and page.

items.name: Wuying Cloud Phone
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud service of virtual Android phones run on ARM servers and streamed to users' devices, sold with a built-in Mobile Use Agent and an Agentic Mobile option that runs Qwen-driven agents in the phones.

items.name: Static-FineBench
items.summary: Data for FineState-Bench, a fine-grained GUI state-control benchmark: desktop, web and mobile screenshots with XML and JSON annotations of locate and interact instructions and separate localization and interaction boxes.

items.name: Opera Neon
items.summary: Opera's subscription agentic browser whose Neon Do agent opens, closes and acts across tabs inside the user's logged-in session, with task workspaces, prompt cards and MCP or CLI access for outside agents.

items.name: Auto-UI
items.summary: Trained Auto-UI checkpoints and BLIP-processed AITW features for a chain-of-action agent that predicts device actions from screenshots, previous actions and planned future actions.

items.name: DeskForge-Qwen3.5-4B
items.summary: DeskForge-Qwen3.5-4B is a desktop GUI model that turns a screenshot and instruction into a next-action pyautogui call with screen-relative coordinates.

items.name: AgentNet
items.summary: 22.6K human-annotated desktop computer-use tasks on Windows, macOS and Ubuntu, released with OpenCUA for training and evaluating vision-language-action models.

items.name: KV-Ground-4B-BaseQw3vl
items.summary: A 4B GUI grounding model for high-resolution screenshots and text instructions, fine-tuned from Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct with supervised and reward-based training.

items.name: world_model_for_wa_desc_with_tao_dataset
items.summary: Training data for the world model of the WMA web agent: 14744 steps pairing an objective, previous actions, an observation and the current action with the next state and a description of what changed.

items.name: VeriOS-Agent-32B
items.summary: VeriOS-Agent-32B is a query-driven OS agent checkpoint initialized from Qwen2.5-VL-32B. It is released with model weights for the interaction approach described in the VeriOS paper.

items.name: Browserbase Cloud
items.summary: Managed browser infrastructure for agent applications.

items.name: Fellou
items.summary: Fellou's agentic browser, which drafts a step-by-step plan for review and then browses, fills forms and runs scheduled or parallel tasks; a Computer Use mode extends it to local apps and files.

items.name: GLM-4.5V
items.summary: A released vision-language model that documents screen reading, icon recognition, visual-element grounding and desktop operation assistance among its supported tasks.

items.name: Screen2AX-Task
items.summary: A macOS UI grounding dataset that pairs application screenshots and action commands with target bounding boxes and visual descriptions.

items.name: Pointer
items.summary: Pointer describes a desktop computer-use agent with feasibility checks, milestone planning, and an executor that combines GUI, code, and browser tools.

items.name: Holo1.5 7B
items.summary: H Company's Qwen2.5-VL-7B-based Holo1.5 checkpoint for locating interface elements and answering questions about screens across web, desktop and mobile, trained with supervised fine-tuning then GRPO.

items.name: ScreenParse
items.summary: Dense screen-parsing data that labels the visible UI elements of rendered web screenshots with boxes, 55 element classes, text, interactability and reading order, generated by an automated crawl-and-filter pipeline.

items.name: InternVL3_5-1B-HF
items.summary: HF-format InternVL3.5-1B checkpoint with a 0.3B vision encoder and 0.8B language model, from a multimodal family trained with Cascade RL that lists GUI interaction among its capabilities.

items.name: Playwright MCP
items.summary: An MCP server that gives LLM clients browser navigation and interaction tools. It identifies page elements through structured accessibility snapshots.

items.name: Qwen3-8B-FormFactory-SFT-LoRA
items.summary: A Qwen3-8B LoRA adapter fine-tuned on 992 demonstrations for filling web forms in FormFactory, released with instructions for loading it through PEFT.

items.name: asil-qwen35-9b-sft
items.summary: An ASIL supervised fine-tuning checkpoint for an application-control approach based on structured state and semantic actions, released with loadable model weights.

items.name: AutoDroid V2 training data
items.summary: Conversation-formatted supervision released for fine-tuning AutoDroid V2, with the project documenting a ShareGPT-style JSON configuration.

items.name: ASIL Benchmark
items.summary: ASIL Benchmark releases indexed software-agent tasks for single-application and multi-application evaluation, with task definitions and public assets.

items.name: FSB v0.9.92
items.summary: Chrome extension for natural-language browser automation that accepts a user's request and browses on their behalf.

items.name: GUI-Actor-Verifier-2B
items.summary: A GUI grounding verifier that checks whether a marked screenshot position matches an instruction and provides a score for candidate action positions.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) Qwen3.5-9B OSWorld SFT
items.summary: Supervised Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, released as the start point that online RL initializes from for its OSWorld computer-use agent.

items.name: UGround-single
items.summary: A GUI grounding dataset with 8.29 million training rows that pair image references and element requests with bounding-box coordinates and click actions.

items.name: OS-Atlas Pro 7B
items.summary: OS-Atlas action checkpoint fine-tuned from OS-Atlas-Base-7B that reads a screenshot, task and history and writes a thought plus the next basic or user-defined GUI action, in the Qwen2-VL architecture.

items.name: ClawBench
items.summary: A browser-agent task corpus for everyday work on live websites, with V1 and V2 test splits, task context, and schemas that intercept final submissions.

items.name: GTA1-7B
items.summary: A released GUI grounding checkpoint trained with GRPO to predict an element's coordinates from a screenshot and description, with inference code and reported evaluations.

items.name: SWEeper-Bench
items.summary: SWEeper-Bench provides tasks drawn from web application bugs for evaluating agents that inspect running apps and repair them. Each task includes a prompt, repository revisions, and browser behavior tests.

items.name: GUI-G1 3B v1
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-3B checkpoint released for R1-style visual grounding experiments, predicting interface target locations from screenshots and instructions.

items.name: Mind2Web-cleaned-lite-value-model-w-cot-test
items.summary: A Mind2Web dataset of 6125 web-action records with element candidates, accessibility trees, prior actions, rationales, and value scores.

items.name: UGround-V1-Data-Box
items.summary: UGround-V1-Data-Box contains Web-Hybrid and Web-Direct GUI grounding data with images and conversations; its bounding-box version uses normalized coordinates.

items.name: Browser Operator
items.summary: Browser Operator is Opera's preview browser agent for carrying out natural-language browsing tasks while showing its steps and allowing user takeover.

items.name: Holo3
items.summary: Holo3 is a computer-use model family trained on synthetic navigation and enterprise workflows. Its publisher reports desktop benchmark results and offers inference access and an open checkpoint.

items.name: CAGUI
items.summary: Chinese Android GUI benchmark released with AgentCPM-GUI, with a grounding track for widgets and OCR text and an agent track for multi-step tasks in Chinese apps.

items.name: Firecrawl
items.summary: Hosted web data API for AI agents that searches and scrapes pages into Markdown or JSON, with an Interact endpoint and browser sandbox in which prompts or Playwright code click, type and fill forms.

items.name: Asteroid

items.name: PrivScreen
items.summary: PrivScreen is a dataset associated with research on protecting privacy in mobile-agent screenshots; its repository contains images and question-answer files.

items.name: weboperator-experiments
items.summary: Run logs of the WebOperator web agent with gpt-4o on 812 WebArena tasks and a 155-task WebArena-lite ablation, holding per-task trajectories, search trees, screenshots and scores.

items.name: Go-Browse-WA processed data
items.summary: Flattened web-interaction training records with accessibility-tree observations, assistant completions, trajectory rewards and step-link metadata.

items.name: tti_webarena
items.summary: TTI-WebArena checkpoint from the Test-Time Interaction work, a multimodal web agent trained with online filtered behavior cloning on WebArena tasks and set in the TTI evaluation configs.

items.name: Sai on OSWorld v2.1 reference-VM runs
items.summary: Simular's 134 clean runs of its Sai computer-use agent on the 108 OSWorld v2.1 tasks in a reference Ubuntu VM, with OSWorld trajectories, agent records, harness and grader logs, scorecards and screenshot and video tars.

items.name: OS-Genesis 4B AW

items.name: OmniJev-SFT-0.8B
items.summary: Generative SFT baseline from the OmniJev release: a LoRA adapter over Qwen3.5-0.8B, trained for 12,500 steps, that answers image questions with text; the card reports scores on AndroidControl, web and phone families.

items.name: Online-Mind2Web task data
items.summary: Gated Hub release of the Online-Mind2Web task set: one JSON test split of tasks on live websites, 300 tasks on 136 sites per the project README, which the publishers revise when sites change.

items.name: Holo3 35B-A3B
items.summary: A sparse Qwen3.5-based GUI-action checkpoint released for navigation and computer-use workflows.

items.name: MWMBench
items.summary: MWMBench evaluates mobile GUI world models by asking them to predict the next screen from a screenshot and coordinate action.

items.name: Preflight Bench
items.summary: A dataset of paired screenshots, click outcomes and checker answers for evaluating pre-click checks on changing web pages. It includes Lance tables and development and test splits.

items.name: Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct
items.summary: Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct is a vision-language checkpoint whose card reports performance on desktop agent interaction and screen grounding alongside general multimodal tasks.

items.name: SeeClick-aitw
items.summary: SeeClick visual GUI agent checkpoint fine-tuned on Android in the Wild (AITW) episodes and scored on the AITW test set by action matching with the SeeClick agent-task scripts.

items.name: Fara 7B
items.summary: Microsoft's Fara checkpoint, a Qwen2.5-VL-architecture image-text-to-text model with about 8.3B BF16 parameters, English, MIT-licensed and linked to arXiv paper 2511.19663.

items.name: OpenJev-Data
items.summary: OpenJev-Data provides labeled browser steps for training models to choose a web agent's next operation and target element, plus a fixed test set for endpoint evaluation.

items.name: Browser Run
items.summary: Browser Run hosts headless Chrome sessions for browser automation and agent browsing, with Playwright, Puppeteer, CDP and MCP integration options.

items.name: WebRL Llama 3.1 8B
items.summary: A WebRL browser-policy checkpoint for performing actions in the five website environments of WebArena.

items.name: Holotron4 30B-A3B FP8

items.name: MolmoPoint-GUISyn

items.name: GroundAnything-VLM

items.name: InSTA 150k Tasks (v3)
items.summary: About 150k web navigation tasks from the InSTA project, each giving a website domain, an instruction, suggested steps and success criteria, with train and test splits drawn from different websites.

items.name: V2P-7B
items.summary: A GUI grounding checkpoint that takes a screenshot and instruction to locate interaction coordinates. V2P suppresses background attention and emphasizes target centers.

items.name: Qwen-CUA
items.summary: Qwen-CUA is a screenshot-based computer-use model that generates grounded keyboard and mouse actions. Its release includes weights and a browser reference runtime.

items.name: UI-TARS 7B DPO
items.summary: DPO-labelled 7B UI-TARS checkpoint that its card marks as recommended: a native GUI agent model in the Qwen2-VL architecture for screen perception, element grounding and multi-step actions on web, mobile and desktop.

items.name: Holo1.5 72B
items.summary: The 72B member of H Company's Holo1.5 series, fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct for UI element localization and screen question answering on web, desktop and mobile interfaces.

items.name: GUI-Owl 32B
items.summary: The 32B GUI-Owl checkpoint from the Mobile-Agent-v3 project, fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct for GUI grounding and actions, and usable as specialized agents in the Mobile-Agent-v3 framework.

items.name: LexBench-WebArena-Replay
items.summary: LexBench-WebArena-Replay pairs WebArena task definitions with fixed browser actions so Browser Eval can replay them and score completion across a published 812-task set.

items.name: GUI-Drag
items.summary: Data for learning text-dragging interactions in graphical interfaces.

items.name: OmniJev-2B
items.summary: OmniJev decision adapter for Qwen3.5-2B: LoRA weights and heads that return probabilities for typed questions about screens, video and robot scenes, evaluated on web and phone task families.

items.name: Building AI Browser Agents
items.summary: Browser-agent course with worked lessons on structured web extraction and multi-step browser interaction, followed by AgentQ search and self-correction concepts.

items.name: CMGUI
items.summary: 18k trajectories with 98k steps from more than 50 Chinese mobile apps in domains such as e-commerce and social media, for building GUI agents on Chinese apps.

items.name: ACT-SOP
items.summary: LoRA adapter for Llama-2-7b from MobileAgent, a mobile device control agent that adds Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) context and predicts actions on AitW screens.

items.name: Aguvis-7B-720P
items.summary: Aguvis-7B-720P, the released Aguvis checkpoint: a vision-only GUI agent model trained first for grounding and then for planning and reasoning, acting from screenshots on web, desktop and mobile.

items.name: WebRewardBench
items.summary: An offline preference-evaluation set for web process reward models, pairing page and trajectory context with preferred and rejected candidate decisions.

items.name: Holo4 27B BF16
items.summary: Dense 27B computer-use checkpoint from H Company built on Qwen3.8-27B; an external harness sends it screenshots and tool results and executes the clicks, typing, code and tool calls it requests.

items.name: Holo4 27B GGUF
items.summary: Q4_K_M GGUF release of the Holo4-27B computer-use model with a separate F16 vision projector; an external harness sends it screenshots and tool results and executes the actions and tool calls it requests.

items.name: OpenCUA 32B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based computer-use checkpoint that combines screenshot history with planning and grounded executable actions.

items.name: UI-Mate-27B

items.name: InternVL3-14B

items.name: GUI-Libra 3B
items.summary: GUI-Libra checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (about 4.07B BF16 parameters) that turns a screenshot, task and action history into a <think> reasoning block and a JSON action with point_2d coordinates.

items.name: DroidCall data
items.summary: Instruction-to-function-call examples for learning Android intent invocation, with training, testing and API-annotation files for mobile task execution.

items.name: GUI-Owl 7B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based GUI checkpoint released with Mobile-Agent-v3 for grounded actions and specialized roles in its agent framework.

items.name: Gelato OS-World agent trajectories
items.summary: Gelato-30B-A3B and GTA1-32B OS-World agent runs, three trials each in the same GPT-5-planned GTA1.5-based harness, with per-task trajectories, initial and step screenshots, and automated results.

items.name: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-NVFP4
items.summary: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-NVFP4 is a quantized computer-use vision-language checkpoint for web, desktop and mobile tasks, with function-calling support.

items.name: lumos_unified_ground_iterative
items.summary: A released Lumos grounding-module checkpoint fine-tuned on web-agent and other interactive tasks within its modular language-agent system.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) Qwen3.5-9B ScienceBoard SFT
items.summary: Supervised Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, released as the start point that online RL initializes from for its ScienceBoard computer-use agent.

items.name: GUIrilla-Task
items.summary: macOS screenshots paired with generated instructions and a ground-truth click or type action on a labelled element, collected by the GUIrilla accessibility-API crawler in app-disjoint train and test splits.

items.name: GUI-Owl 7B Desktop-RL
items.summary: GUI-Owl 7B variant from Mobile-Agent-v3 that is RL-tuned for desktop use on OSWorld, released as a research checkpoint for validating environment-RL improvements, with production use outside its stated purpose.

items.name: UI2Code_N
items.summary: A visual language model that turns UI screenshots into code and supports iterative interface editing and polishing. Its card includes a screenshot-to-HTML inference example.

items.name: ChatGPT Agent
items.summary: Hosted agent combining browser interaction, tools, and computer-based tasks.

items.name: UiPath ScreenPlay
items.summary: UiPath Studio activity whose Screen Agent turns natural-language task descriptions into self-driving UI automations on Windows, Linux and macOS, using a planner, a pixel grounder, DOM extraction and selectable LLMs.

items.name: lumos_unified_ground_iterative-13B
items.summary: A released Lumos grounding-module checkpoint fine-tuned on web-agent tasks alongside question answering, multimodal and math tasks.

items.name: lora_qformer_uitars_test_V1-400_merged
items.summary: UI-TARS-V1.5-7B checkpoint with CoMEM continuous memory merged in, where a LoRA-tuned Q-Former compresses retrieved GUI trajectories into fixed-length embeddings for the web agent.

items.name: Holo4-27B-NVFP4
items.summary: A quantized Holo4 vision-language checkpoint for computer use across web, desktop, and mobile interfaces, with a harness that executes requested GUI and tool actions.

items.name: OS-Genesis 4B AC
items.summary: InternVL2-4B checkpoint fine-tuned on OS-Genesis AndroidControl trajectories; its card prompt pairs a screenshot and accessibility tree with the goal and action history to produce the next thought and action.

items.name: android_icon_dataset
items.summary: A labeled Android icon dataset for studying visual interface elements. Its train split contains images and string class labels.

items.name: InternVL3-38B
items.summary: A released InternVL3-38B multimodal checkpoint from a model family whose card documents GUI-operation training samples and GUI-grounding evaluation.

items.name: pix2struct-large

items.name: WebGenAgent-LM-8B-SFT

items.name: MobBench task definitions

items.name: WorldGUI-Bench

items.name: Dia

items.name: Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking
items.summary: A vision-language checkpoint whose card describes visual-agent operation of PC and mobile interfaces, including element recognition and tool use.

items.name: Holo4 Trajectories

items.name: microsoft/OmniParser

items.name: bevaya/RICO-ScreenQA-Complex

items.summary: UGround-V1 checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen2-VL-7B, with about 8.3B BF16 parameters in the standard Qwen2-VL architecture, provided as safetensors and a PyTorch file under Apache-2.0.

items.name: DeskForge-1M
items.summary: A desktop GUI dataset with screenshots, element annotations, and action records, released with training, validation, and varied application, theme, and resolution test splits.

items.name: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-MobileWorld-SFT
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on the MobileWorld dataset as a semantic world model that describes in natural language how a mobile GUI screen changes after an action, for planning by mobile agents.

items.name: OpenJev-4B
items.summary: A local decision model that scores typed options for browser-agent operations and target elements. The release includes weights and reports browser-step evaluations.

items.name: Magma-R1
items.summary: Magma-R1 is a released GUI-agent model trained on curated AndroidControl samples. Its accompanying documentation describes action and grounding evaluation and reward-based training.

items.name: Computer Agents
items.summary: A cloud agent platform that gives agents persistent computers with browser, GUI, terminal, and file access, alongside project workspaces and workflow triggers.

items.name: NAIL-Group/ClawBenchV1Trace
items.summary: ClawBench V1 Traces releases browser-agent run records with screen video, actions, network traffic and agent messages for replay, debugging and regrading.

items.name: Two-Box Judge GUI Dataset
items.summary: Training data for BAMI's local correction model: pairs of cropped GUI screenshots that each highlight one candidate box, with a click command and an automatic label for the box that fits it.

items.name: OpenPhone_dataset
items.summary: Training data for the OpenPhone mobile agent: the AndroidLab training archive plus a Hugging Face vision-language set with LLM-generated reasoning and reflection chains, formatted for GRPO training.

items.name: AutomotiveUI-Bench-4K
items.summary: Offline test set of 998 photos and screenshots of in-vehicle infotainment screens from 15 brands, with 4,208 English annotations for locating UI elements and judging expected results as passed or failed.

items.name: Magma-Mind2Web-SoM
items.summary: Magma-Mind2Web-SoM provides Mind2Web data for downstream fine-tuning of the Magma multimodal agent model.

items.name: ClawGUI-Eval
items.summary: GUI grounding evaluation data for six benchmarks, with images, prompts, and prior outputs for an inference, judging, and metrics workflow.

items.name: sharryXR/asil-training-data
items.summary: Training data for ASIL agents includes replayed action traces, guided supervision, and an evaluator-backed reinforcement-learning curriculum in JSONL and Parquet splits.

items.name: WebRetriever
items.summary: A web-agent benchmark with navigation, documentation-guided navigation and end-to-end information-extraction protocols across 1,550 tasks.

items.name: Screen2AX-Element
items.summary: A dataset of macOS application screenshots with UI element boxes and category labels for training and evaluating interface element detectors.

items.name: browserground-mlx
items.summary: browserground-mlx is a 4-bit MLX conversion of a browser grounding model for Apple Silicon. It accepts a screenshot and a target description to locate an interface element.

items.name: Dreamer V1 Data
items.summary: Web-world-model training data with prompts, images, action descriptions, and responses, released with the WebDreamer project.

items.name: lumos_unified_plan_iterative-13B
items.summary: A Lumos planning checkpoint fine-tuned on web-agent, question-answering, multimodal and math tasks within a modular agent system.

items.name: ChilleD/WildAWM
items.summary: WildAWM provides 341 computer-use tasks across CLI, MCP, and web interfaces, with frozen task worlds and training and test splits for Harbor runs.

items.name: BugCraft
items.summary: A vision-based agent that converts Minecraft crash reports into reproduction steps and executes them through a macro API. Its project page also describes BugCraft-Bench.

items.name: Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking is a vision-language checkpoint whose card describes recognizing interface elements and using tools to complete PC and mobile GUI tasks.

items.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: AWS managed agent platform whose Browser tool runs isolated cloud browser sessions with automation and live-view streams and optional recording, alongside runtime, memory, gateway and code-execution services.

items.name: Holo2 30B-A3B
items.summary: Mixture-of-experts Holo2 checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking through supervised and online RL stages for UI element localization and multi-step navigation on web, desktop and mobile screens.

items.name: go-browse-wa-raw
items.summary: go-browse-wa-raw is a browser-agent trajectory dataset with page observations, actions, goals, rewards, and images. Its train split contains 196462 examples.

items.name: James4Ever0/the_frozen_forest
items.summary: A dataset archive of screen recordings paired with keyboard and mouse events. Timestamp files align video frames with recorded input actions.

items.name: GUIChat
items.summary: Conversational GUI supervision with text-rich images and bounding boxes, organized as single-turn questions and multi-turn dialogues.

items.name: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-GGUF
items.summary: A quantized Holo3.1 vision-language checkpoint for computer-use agents across web, desktop, and mobile interfaces, with UI grounding and function calling.

items.name: Browser Use Cloud
items.summary: Hosted browser-agent platform from Browser Use.

items.name: axiom.ai
items.summary: Axiom provides browser automation through a Chrome extension, APIs, and an MCP server. AI clients can create and run workflows on cloud browsers or a local desktop.

items.name: Hcompany/Holo4-35B-A3B-NVFP4
items.summary: Holo4-35B-A3B-NVFP4 is an NVFP4 computer-use vision-language checkpoint that consumes screenshots and tool results to request interface actions through an agent harness.

items.name: Surfer 2
items.summary: Surfer 2 is a computer-use agent for desktop, web and mobile tasks. Its orchestrator assigns subtasks while components handle visual grounding and execution.

items.name: Yutori
items.summary: Yutori's web-agent platform: the Navigator computer-use model API (n1.5 for browsers, n2 for full desktops), task APIs for browsing, research and Scout web monitoring, and the Delegate personal agent.

items.name: Computer Use Large (markov-ai)
items.summary: 48,478 trimmed, audio-free screen-recording videos (about 12,300 hours) of AutoCAD, Blender, Excel, Photoshop, Salesforce and VS Code use, gathered from the internet, with duration metadata and no action labels.

items.name: OpenMobile-2 extended Android AVDs
items.summary: Seven preconfigured Pixel 6 emulator images for Android API 33 (arm64) with an Apple Silicon install script, listed in the OpenMobile-2 release as its extended Android AVDs.

items.name: Operator
items.summary: Historical OpenAI browser-agent research preview.

items.name: Qwen3-8B-CK-Pro
items.summary: Qwen3-8B-CK-Pro is the CK-Pro-8B agent foundation model from Cognitive Kernel-Pro, fine-tuned from Qwen3-8B on self-collected trajectories; the card reports 32.7% Pass@1 on the GAIA dev set.

items.name: FiftyOne GUI Grounding Training Set
items.summary: 739 GUI screenshots, mostly macOS browser views, labeled with interaction points, action types and per-action task descriptions in a COCO4GUI-based FiftyOne format for element grounding and click prediction.

items.name: CUA_World_State_Model
items.summary: SEAgent's World State Model, a Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct fine-tune that assesses computer-use trajectories step by step from screenshots, used to label successes and failures and to drive curriculum task generation.

items.name: UI-R1 3B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL checkpoint trained with reinforcement learning for GUI action prediction and evaluated on mobile, desktop and web grounding tasks.

items.name: OS-Genesis 8B WA
items.summary: WebArena-oriented InternVL2-8B checkpoint trained on web trajectories from OS-Genesis reverse task synthesis; the card's example prompt pairs a screenshot and accessibility tree with the instruction and action history.

items.name: WaveUI-25k
items.summary: A 24,978-example subset of an ~80k UI element collection, pairing screenshots and instructions with target boxes and annotated element names, descriptions, types, OCR, purposes and click expectations.

items.name: OneJev-Data
items.summary: OneJev-Data releases 94,707 question-and-answer training rows spanning GUI-agent runs, screens, images, video and text in Parquet files.

items.name: Holo1 7B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based action model released for the Surfer-H web-agent system, supporting policy, interface-localization and validation roles.

items.name: Holotron 3 Nano
items.summary: Computer-use policy checkpoint that H Company post-trained from NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, a hybrid Mamba-MoE model with 3B of 30B parameters active per token, aimed at lower-latency agent workloads.

items.name: Holo4-35B-A3B-FP8
items.summary: An FP8 vision-language checkpoint for computer use. With an agent harness, it processes screenshots and tool results to request clicks, typing, code and tool calls.

items.name: OpenWebVoyager-opt-2
items.summary: The second optimization-iteration checkpoint of OpenWebVoyager, an idefics2-8b multimodal web agent trained by imitation learning and then refined on successful real-website trajectories kept by GPT-4o feedback.

items.name: GUI-Libra 7B
items.summary: GUI-Libra checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (about 8.29B BF16 parameters) that turns a screenshot, task and action history into a <think> reasoning block and a JSON action with point_2d coordinates.

items.name: GUI-Xplore
items.summary: Per-app Android exploration videos with screenshot and action sequences, view hierarchies and question-answer pairs for five tasks, from app overview and page analysis to action recall and sequence verification.

items.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) GLM-4.6V-Flash OSWorld SFT
items.summary: Supervised GLM-4.6V-Flash checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, released as the start point that online RL initializes from for its OSWorld desktop computer-use agent.

items.name: TianXi_Action_Grounding_7B
items.summary: A 7B GUI action-grounding model from the SEA computer-use agent work, released as Qwen2_5_VL safetensors weights; its GitHub repository runs it on ScreenSpot-Pro across instruction styles and languages.

items.name: GUI_Reflection_Task_Suite_train
items.summary: Training split of the GUI Reflection Task Suite: JSONL files for action verification, action reversal and mistake-informed reattempt, built on AndroidControl, GUI Odyssey, AMEX, OS-Atlas and Wave UI.

items.name: GroundCUA dataset
items.summary: Desktop GUI-grounding data from the GroundCUA project: PNG screenshots of 87 applications paired by hash with JSON lists of element boxes, visible text and optional coarse categories.

items.name: GUI-Libra-81K-SFT
items.summary: SFT release of GUI-Libra-81K: per-step reasoning traces and coordinate-grounded actions over web and Android screenshots, in JSON annotation files with full, no-reasoning and 1,000-sample variants.

items.name: ShowUI-π checkpoint
items.summary: A compact visual-action checkpoint that predicts continuous GUI drag trajectories from a screenshot and a natural-language instruction.

items.name: cua-s1-forms-coreml
items.summary: A Core ML conversion of CUA-S1-FORMS scores candidate actions for forms from task and element text. It provides portable and compiled packages for Apple devices.

items.name: ZeroGUI-AndroidLab-7B
items.summary: ZeroGUI-AndroidLab-7B is a GUI-agent checkpoint associated with training that generates interface tasks, estimates rewards from screenshots, and adapts through online reinforcement learning.

items.name: agent-qa
items.summary: QA agent for browser and mobile apps that executes actions through Playwright and Appium, verifies steps, and records runs. Its publisher reports completing all AndroidWorld tasks.

items.name: Aria-UI Data
items.summary: GUI element descriptions and grounding instructions spanning web, mobile, and Ubuntu desktop interfaces.

items.name: ACT-1
items.summary: Adept's 2022 action transformer, previewed in demo videos of a Chrome extension that reads a custom rendering of the page and clicks, types and scrolls on its UI elements to carry out typed requests.

items.name: Muse Spark 1.1
items.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs multimodal reasoning model for agentic work, trained to choose between writing scripts and clicking in computer-use workflows that span several applications.

items.name: Achieving 91.4% on Android World: A New Approach to Mobile UI Automation
items.summary: Technical article describing an Android UI agent that alternates planning with single actions, checks screen changes and uses a dedicated text editing path. It reports AndroidWorld results.

items.name: ShowUI Desktop
items.summary: 7,496 desktop grounding examples built from OmniAct screenshots, with annotations rewritten by GPT-4o to describe element appearance, spatial relations and function.

items.name: WebRL-GLM-4-9B
items.summary: A GLM-based WebRL model released for browser tasks across five WebArena websites. Its card reports evaluation results on WebArena-Lite.

items.name: GTA1-7B
items.summary: Released GUI grounding checkpoint trained with reinforcement learning to predict click coordinates from screenshots and instructions, with inference examples and reported benchmark results.

items.name: TimeWarp-GPT5-Traces
items.summary: GPT-5 teacher trajectories on the TimeWarp web benchmark, grouped by UI version, with SoM-annotated screenshots for each step and experiment logs, used to fine-tune web agents with LlamaFactory.

items.name: Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506
items.summary: A multimodal reasoning model with released weights and high-resolution image input. Its authors report GUI grounding evaluations on ScreenSpot-Pro, ScreenSpot-V2 and OSWorld-G.

items.name: ZHEN-04/CaptchaAgent
items.summary: ZHEN-04/CaptchaAgent is a 9B computer-use policy trained on interactive CAPTCHA trajectories. It maps screenshots to tool calls and provides SFT and reinforcement-learning checkpoints.

items.name: GLM-4.5V-FP8
items.summary: A vision-language model release with FP8 weights whose card documents screen reading, icon recognition, desktop assistance and visual element localization.

items.name: WebPRM checklist-generation data
items.summary: Web-task context, starting observations and action history paired with structured checklists and subgoal analyses for checklist generation.

items.name: UGround-V1-2B
items.summary: UGround-V1-2B is a Qwen2-VL-based checkpoint for locating targets in GUI screenshots, with reported evaluations on mobile, desktop, and web screens.

items.name: GUI-Dense-Descriptions
items.summary: A dataset of GUI screenshots paired with dense text descriptions, released as a train split containing 1,263 image-text examples.

items.name: Narada Code and OperatorMini
items.summary: Narada Code develops and tests computer-use workflows, then revises them after failures. OperatorMini executes the instructions for repeatable web and enterprise tasks.

items.name: E2B
items.summary: Sandbox infrastructure for executing agent workloads.

items.name: UI-TARS 72B SFT
items.summary: SFT-labelled 72B UI-TARS checkpoint: a native GUI agent model in the Qwen2-VL architecture, stored in FP32, for screen perception, element grounding and multi-step actions on web, mobile and desktop.

items.name: LGWM data and RSWT-Bench
items.summary: A dataset of GUI screen transitions for training a world model, released with RSWT-Bench to evaluate whether observed screens follow the intended actions.

items.name: Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ
items.summary: This instruction-tuned Qwen2.5-VL checkpoint supports visual localization and tool-directed computer and phone use. The repository provides weights and inference examples.

items.name: ScreenDrag
items.summary: GUI dragging data with screen observations, prior state, and continuous pointer actions, provided as trajectory files and Parquet representations.

items.name: qianhuiwu/GUI-Actor-7B-Qwen2.5-VL-LiteTrain
items.summary: A GUI-grounding checkpoint built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with an attention-based action head. Its example predicts a click point from a screenshot and instruction.

items.name: InternVL3_5-2B
items.summary: InternVL3.5-2B checkpoint with a 0.3B vision encoder and 2.0B language model, from a multimodal family trained with Cascade RL that lists GUI interaction among its capabilities.

items.name: Seg2Click Qwen3.5 2B
items.summary: Seg2Click checkpoint using a 2B Qwen3.5 backbone to predict a mask and select an interface click.

items.name: ScaleCUA 7B
items.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based computer-use checkpoint with direct grounding and agent action modes across desktop, mobile and web interfaces.

items.name: Magma-AITW-SoM
items.summary: Magma-AITW-SoM supplies AITW data used to fine-tune the Magma multimodal agent model for downstream tasks.
